text:
incident-bot: SEV2 created: multiple inference pods in us-west-2 reporting OOM / CUDA errors and container restarts. auto-notify oncall.

maya: acked — oncall here, picking this up. what's the customer impact? @product-ops

product-ops: seeing a spike in 503s for customers using /v1/generate on hosted clusters. small subset (~4% requests) fail with 5xx. support has two tickets so far.

linus: adding logs from one affected pod. pasted:
```
2026-03-16T19:14:12.342Z ERROR runtime: cuda: out of memory when allocating 256MB for kv_cache_page (alloc attempt 1)
2026-03-16T19:14:12.343Z WARN runtime: falling back to paged attention; eviction suggested
2026-03-16T19:14:12.350Z CRIT container: process exited (SIGABRT)
```

raj: notes — pattern looks like slow KV cache fragmentation causing incremental resident set growth until CUDA OOM. pods then crash and restart loop. no node-wide oom kills yet.

maya: running quick triage: `kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide | grep inference-service` shows 6/12 pods restarting.

maya: trying soft mitigation -> evict the most noisy pods: `kubectl delete pod inference-service-5f7d -n inference` to allow scheduler to place fresh container on different GPU.

linus: while we do that, reduce traffic to the pool and enable model fallback to smaller variant. ops runbook snippet:
```
PATCH /routing/pools/hosted-us-west-2
{"max_qps": 0.6, "fallback_model": "redwood-small-v1"}
```

emma: executed routing patch, reduced qps to the pool. observed immediate drop in 5xx rate.

sre-bot: NOTE: cordoning node ip-10-0-5-12.usw2 suspected of repeated restarts (3 restarts in 10m). `kubectl cordon ip-10-0-5-12` queued.

raj: spun up an extra node in the dedicated pool to ease placement pressure. watching for new pods staying up.

maya: quick hotfix applied to runtime: enabled aggressive KV page sweep (~30s) via feature-flag on affected nodes. command: `rwctl runtime set-flag --name=kv_sweep_interval --value=30 --pool=hosted-us-west-2`

linus: after sweep flag, two pods stayed up for 20+ minutes (vs previous ~3–5). memory growth slowed. looks like compaction wasn't triggering early enough.

product-ops: update to customers sent: short degraded experience for some users; failover to smaller model reduced errors. currently no major data loss.

emma: gathering core dumps/log bundles for eng-runtime. attaching pod names to the incident.

raj: creating short-term alert: if restarts > 2 in 15m for a pod, automatically divert traffic from pool. will file alert rule PR.

maya: handing off to eng-runtime for deeper root-cause and postmortem. oncall remains watching for 2 hours. escalation: @linus please own postmortem.

linus: on it. next steps: 1) collect heap profiles & kv bitmap stats; 2) reproduce with smaller seq lengths; 3) check kernel selection differences for affected GPUs; 4) follow up with quantization/allocator patch.

incident-bot: SEV2 updated -> mitigation in place, customer impact reduced. tagged eng-runtime, support notified.

maya: thanks everyone. I'll leave runbook notes and the traffic rollback plan in the incident doc. :thumbsup:
